payload.description_html: Life restoration of the recently described mosasaurine mosasaur, Thoraxion tahlequaha. Body proportions are based on the skeletal provided within the description of Thoraxion (Sharpe, 2026), as well as the tail shape referenced from  "Convergence in aquatic locomotion: reconstructing mosasaurian (Squamata: Mosasauria) tail fins from osteological correlates and covariation with extant sharks" (Song, 2025).
